blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sixteen teachers and students were injured following tensions with police at a protest outside Malacañang on Sunday, a day before World Teachers’ Day, the Alliance of Concerned Teachers (ACT) said. The group said the protesters were calling for economic relief, including a P50,000 entry-level salary for teachers, a P5,000 Personnel Economic Relief Allowance, increased funding for education, and broader reforms in the education sector. READ: Teachers’ group bats for P50,000 entry pay, more spending for education ACT alleged that the personal belongings of five protesters were damaged and that two megaphones were forcibly taken and broken by police.
